title: Stage path and kanban read the select option's lifecycle kind: terminal options drawn apart from the steps, lost ones marked, instead of guessing from closed_won / closed_lost spelling
body:
## Source

Walked on 2026-10-27 on the published console 18.2.0 with HotCRM: the lead stage path draws 未通过 as the fifth step; the opportunity path draws Closed Won / ✗ Closed Lost apart only because the renderer recognises those two values by name. The spec's option `kind` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23809) is published; nothing in `ui/packages/plugin-detail` (the stage path) or `ui/packages/plugin-kanban` (column order) reads it yet. HotCRM declares the kinds in its own card (objectstack-ai/hotcrm, filed beside this one).

## Target

1. The stage path lays out the open options as steps and the terminal options at the end as outcomes: the won/done one with a check when reached, the lost one with ✗ and never as a step; a record in a lost state shows the path stopped at its last open step with the lost chip.
2. The kanban orders columns open → done → lost, and collapses lost columns by default with a count.
3. The name-based guess (`closed_won` / `closed_lost`) stays as the fallback for packages that declare no kind, with a dev-mode warning naming the field.

## File surface

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/` (stage path), `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/`, the field metadata reader in `ui/packages/app-shell`, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a select with kinds renders the path with the lost option apart; without kinds the fallback renders as today with the warning.
2. Screenshots of a lead (未通过) and an opportunity (Closed Lost) at 1280 px.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-27 fifth review: objectstack main `f9867020c6` (Object UI now under `ui/`), HotCRM `1f3f8880` on platform 18.2.0 (the published console at `/_console`, a fresh dev database), the maintainer's browser pane at 955 × 452 (zh-CN), plus cloud staging (the control-plane home and the test1016 tenant's build chat). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed by where the fix lands, verbatim: 「全部立卡，按落点分仓；#25943 让车道正常派发。」</sub>
